content.short: VVS Finance is the first Automated Market Maker (AMM) decentralized exchange native to the Cronos blockchain.
content.description: Founded in 2021, VVS Finance is the first AMM decentralized exchange native to the Cronos blockchain, aiming to provide the simplest DeFi experience for everyone. It is EVM- and IBC-compatible, enabling interaction with other Cosmos chains and cross-chain liquidity between EVM networks and the Cosmos ecosystem. VVS Finance offers a range of decentralized exchange services with very low swap fees and an easy-to-use interface, including Bling Swap, Crystal Farms, Glitter Mines, Initial Gem Offering (IGO), xVVS (yield-bearing governance token), Miner Mole NFT, and VVSgotchi gamification.
